chapter: Childhood and early career in New Orleans
title: Born on Bourbon Street, 1895; mother's singing; catechism school
summary: Lizzie was born in New Orleans on March 31, 1895. Her mother sang only late in life, and Lizzie began singing in catechism school since there was no money for lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born on March the 31st, 1895.
Right here in New Orleans on Bourbon Street.
Were your father and mother musical people?

My mother sings, but not publicly. Only until after she got in her old days, she started singing in old folks' concerts and singing old Creole songs, but when she was young, she didn't. She didn't? Mm-hmm.
Did they send you for musical instruction when you were young?
No, no. My mother wasn't able to send me to how I started singing in my catechism school.
